mapper.select: SELECT sp_tbl_ccp_metal_monitor_c_000(#{coCd}, #{docIdx}, #{baseDt}, #{ccpCd}, #{feSize}, #{stsSize}, #{mngUserId}, #{mngNm}, CAST(#{sensRowsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{passRowsJson} AS jsonb), #{userId})

SELECT d.doc_no AS ref_key, CASE d.status WHEN 'REQ' THEN '결재요청' WHEN 'REV' THEN '결재검토' WHEN 'APV' THEN '결재완료' ELSE d.status END AS target FROM tbl_document d WHERE d.co_cd = #{coCd} AND d.tmpl_cd = #{tmplCd} AND d.del_yn = 'N' AND d.status NOT IN ('TMP', 'RJT') AND d.idx IN #{id} ORDER BY d.doc_no LIMIT 1
